# Installation

The `r pkg("normpatch")` package can be installed directly from GitHub using `BiocManager::install()`.
For typical RNA-seq workflows, we also recommend installing `r pkg("edgeR", "bioc")` and `r pkg("DESeq2", "bioc")`,
which provide DEG testing methods
and optional functions used within DEGES-based normalization.


```{r installation-package, eval=FALSE}
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install(c("edgeR", "DESeq2", "bitdessin/normpatch"))
```
